name: Vitamin B12
description: Cobalt-containing vitamin (cobalamin); cyanocobalamin is the most widely used form

status.humanEvidence: FDA approved; 2 small trials for energy

note.text: Two small placebo-controlled trials of B12 injections found no difference from placebo. No trial for weight loss was found.

bullets: **Label:** essential to growth, cell reproduction, blood formation and myelin synthesis
**Moved** to tissues by transcobalamin I and II; stored mainly in the liver
**Hydroxocobalamin** works equally well, the label says
FDA approved injection for B12 deficiency
2 small placebo trials for energy or fatigue
No trial of B12 injections for weight loss

practical.halfLife: Not established (not stated on the label)
practical.routes: Injection into muscle or under the skin (label)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak within 1 hour (muscle); stored in liver; excreted in urine
practical.monitored: Potassium, hematocrit, reticulocytes, B12, folate, iron

regulatory.text: Compounded methylcobalamin, MIC blends: not approved
Not listed; IV over 100 mL per 12 h banned (M2.2)

references: FDA (DailyMed), Cyanocobalamin Injection USP label, Oct 2023
JAMA Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg, B12 injection vs placebo in singers, Jan 2021
